title: Cheese
lede: Before Cheese sends a message, opens a task, decides a review or manages members for you, it checks whether that is what you want done. When it isn't sure, it asks you in its reply or in the panel first. Only you can change this page.

ask.title: Confirmation needed
ask.desc: Cheese asks you to confirm these actions every time before taking them.

allow.title: No confirmation needed
allow.desc: Cheese no longer asks you to confirm these actions. It still asks when the target or content doesn't match what you asked for.
allow.hint: For example: answering questions in channels I run

memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: What Cheese noted about you in your panel conversations. Every new conversation uses it. Only your own Cheese uses it; it never appears in channels.
memory.off: Off: Cheese neither uses it nor adds to it. What it noted is kept.
memory.clearBody: Cheese forgets these {n}. This cannot be undone.

routines.title: Routines
routines.desc: What Cheese does on its own, on a clock or when something happens. It tells you how it went.

paused.unfilled: Not filled in — edit it yourself

last.asked: Last run: {n} things waiting for you

routines.deleteBody: It stops running; the conversations it had stay.
routines.filling: Cheese is filling it in: still needs {missing}, then it starts

form.title: Title
form.taskPlaceholder: The address bar's ref (ml-course/tasks/12); empty for any task of mine
form.blankHint: Anything left blank is filled in from the goal, then it starts.

when.mention: Someone {'@'}-mentions me or replies in my thread
when.review: A review is waiting on me
when.due: A challenge is close to due

form.goalRequired: Fill in the goal — it is what Cheese works from.
form.weekdaysRequired: Pick at least one day of the week.
form.taskRequired: Name the task by its address bar ref.

recent.title: Recent actions
recent.empty: Cheese hasn't taken any action others can see for you yet.
